purpose: Six hand-painted sequential right-facing walking poses for classic adventure game; fictional visual reconstruction, not an authenticated historical portrait.
bbox_convention: cell-relative [left, top, right exclusive, bottom exclusive]; alpha_gt_0 preserves low alpha generator noise; alpha_gt_8 defines visible silhouette.
common_crop_method: Union of all six cell-relative alpha>8 bounding boxes, expanded 8 pixels and clipped to 512x512; same crop applied to every frame. Original PNG bytes unchanged.
rendering_note: Use identical crop dimensions, scale and anchor on every pose. Never fit each alpha bounding box separately. Slight drawn body bob and foot differences are natural generated variations.

visual_qa.assessment: Six clearly differing leg and arm poses; stable clothing identity, right-facing whole-body figures; opposite-arm stride alternation is visually evident across cycle halves. Generated rather than rigged animation, so small proportions/height differences remain.

prompt: Create a production 2D adventure-game WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET, 1536 pixels wide x 1024 pixels high, genuinely transparent RGBA background. EXACT layout: 3 columns x 2 rows of 512x512 pixel cells; six complete FULL BODY figures of THE SAME man, one centered within every cell. First supplied image is exact character/clothing reference, second camp is painted style reference only. Character is Captain Thomas Musgrave: middle aged weathered man, dark brown hair with grey, thick dark beard streaked grey, dark navy blue soft naval peaked cap with brass side button, worn navy blue short wool captain jacket with brass buttons and olive patch at upper arm, brown waistcoat, off-white open collar shirt, patched dark brown trousers rolled at cuffs, worn brown lace boots. Hand-painted realistic classic adventure game art, richly detailed brushwork and coherent clothing matching the reference; do not simply repeat the original portrait pose. All six figures face RIGHT in same mostly side profile, slight three-quarter visibility. Same size head and body scale throughout. Top of cap cell y=35, boot ground baseline cell y=480. Center torso x=256. Arms swing freely and natural legs walk. Six visibly DIFFERENT sequential walk frames read left to right top row then bottom row: 1 LEFT leg extended forward heel first and RIGHT leg behind on toe, opposite RIGHT arm forward; 2 left foot planted, body lowered, right knee starting to bend behind; 3 left leg supporting body directly beneath hip, RIGHT knee lifted forward and boot off ground crossing in front, arms near vertical; 4 RIGHT leg extended forward heel first and LEFT leg behind on toe, opposite LEFT arm forward; 5 right foot planted, body lowered, left knee starting to bend behind; 6 right leg supporting body directly beneath hip, LEFT knee lifted forward and boot off ground crossing in front, arms near vertical. Show left/right leg distinction in clothing and occlusion, maintain cycle continuity and life. Coat moves subtly with walking. Both hands relaxed open, neither hand on hip. Every head same height and boots ground baseline consistent. At least 20px margin inside each cell. NO background or color wash, no halo, no ground/cast shadow, no text or numbers, no grid lines, no extra objects. Exactly SIX poses.
